decisions.reason: The manual row-insertion workflow does not change the required alignment of Item and Title with the other Board Meeting fields.
The source specifies how users create and populate a new row but does not change date entry methods, date format, or date-field scope.
Copying fields within a manually inserted Board Meeting row is distinct from copying legacy-document content into new templates and does not resolve or alter the existing paste-workflow ambiguity.
The Board Meeting row-insertion workflow does not change the required theme colors or the policy controlling available color options.
The instruction to copy fields into a newly inserted row does not modify the checklist-and-dropdown configuration of those controls.
The source concerns manual row creation and field copying, not containment of tables or columns pasted from other documents.
The specified row-population sequence does not change whether placeholder text clears when a field is activated.
The Board Meeting row-insertion method has no necessary effect on bullet sizing, spacing, alignment, scaling, or color.
The source establishes when users should enter content into a copied row but does not change Enter-key or multiline-input behavior.
The manual row-insertion workflow does not alter spacing produced by hard returns in continuous text.
Copying Board Meeting fields into a new row does not change the requirement for reliable line breaks after legacy-content pasting.
The source changes the row-insertion procedure but does not change text wrapping or adjacent-column stability requirements.
